card.name: Start of words beginning with le-
card.fires_on: The word piece " le" that opens a longer word, such as levarterenol, leucocyte, lemongrass, levers or letermovir. It responds when a drug or other noun is split after "le".

modes.label: Drug names starting le-
modes.description: The "le" opening a drug name in a list of drugs or vasoconstrictors.
modes.example: If a vasoconstrictor is needed,<< le>>varterenol and phenyleph

modes.label: Other words starting le-
modes.description: The "le" opening an ordinary or lab word in general text.
modes.example: such as the dipstick test for<< le>>ucocyte esterase.

card.writes: It suppresses "lap" and "sch" pieces, so it pushes against those continuations after the opening piece.
card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a word that starts with "le", especially drug names like levarterenol.
